description: Use when a trading agent needs many token prices at once plus the price impact of a buy. Input: tokens (≤25, base:0x… or sol:<mint>, ≤10 Solana), amount_usd (default 1000) or amounts (up to 5 USD sizes). Output: per token priceUsd, confidence, pool, depth and buy estimates: tokensOut, effectivePriceUsd, priceImpactPct (Uniswap v3 QuoterV2 / Aerodrome, Orca CLMM). Example: ?tokens=base:0x4200000000000000000000000000000000000006&amounts=1000,100000 Price: $0.008 USDC (Base or Solana) via x402.

amount_usd.description: Size of the buy to estimate, in USD (default 1000)

amounts.description: Up to 5 USD buy sizes for a price-impact curve (instead of amount_usd); each price row gets trades[]

tokens.description: Comma-separated chain:address list, max 25 (≤10 Solana). Bad input → 400 before payment (not charged)

name: onchain_prices_batch
title: Batch token prices + trade price impact (Base and Solana DEX pools)
